full_judgment: Thus Rule calls in question the judgment and order dated 26.8.89 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Serajganj in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 28 of 1989 allowing the appeal and reversing the judgment and order dated 25.4.88 passed by the Assistant Judge, Serajganj in Miscellaneous Case 62 of 1985 disallowing the pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act (which shall hereinafter be called the Act).
